battle.name: 羅馬-安息戰爭
battle.theater: 上美索不達米亞與幼發拉底河流域
battle.brief: 前66年，羅馬執政官克拉蘇接管敘利亞行省，兵鋒指向安息，前68年在美索不達米亞的卡萊被安息騎射兵與重甲騎兵包圍，六個軍團一朝盡墨，克拉蘇陣亡。卡面的秦弩並非戰場實物，它在此扮演對照件：安息人靠合成弓在奔馳中回身放箭，羅馬人真正依賴的是攻城用的車弩與弩炮。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 羅馬-安息戰爭（前66年－前63年）是羅馬共和國與安息帝國在中亞與美索不達米亞的第一次大規模正面衝突，戰場集中在上美索不達米亞平原、幼發拉底河中游與亞美尼亞東境。開戰的一方是羅馬：執政官馬庫斯·李錫尼·克拉蘇以執政官身分接管敘利亞行省，接替先期入境的蓋烏斯·卡西烏斯·隆吉努斯，兵鋒指向安息控制的美索不達米亞。安息方面的最高統帥是國王歐羅德二世，實際作戰指揮由王室近衛出身的蘇雷納斯掌握，亞美尼亞、查拉塞尼與大益等附庸國家的騎兵亦編入其軍。羅馬陣營裡另有兩位關鍵的附庸君主：亞美尼亞王阿塔瓦德二世與卡帕多西亞的阿卡勞斯；科瑪吉尼的安提柯四世站在羅馬一側，與受安息支持的胞弟爭奪亞美尼亞王位。第三方是兩河流域的商路與絲綢之路西端：安息要把羅馬勢力擋在幼發拉底河東岸，羅馬則要追回被安息扣在美索不達米亞的亞美尼亞王室財富並打開商道。羅馬共和國的補充兵源來自行省的輔助部隊與盟邦騎兵，武器裝備與拉丁式的重裝步兵系統；安息軍則是全套的波斯射術與重甲騎兵系統，兩邊在火力和速度上的取向從一開始就不同。
countriesEn: The Roman-Parthian War of 66-63 BC was the first large-scale frontal clash between the Roman Republic and the Parthian Empire in Central Asia and Mesopotamia, fought on the upper Mesopotamian plain, along the middle Euphrates and on the eastern frontier of Armenia. Rome opened the war: the consul Marcus Licinius Crassus took over the province of Syria as consul, replacing Gaius Cassius Longinus who had entered the region ahead of him, and turned his spearhead towards the Mesopotamian territories held by Parthia. On the Parthian side the supreme command belonged to King Orodes II, while the actual conduct of the battle lay with Surenas, who came from the royal guard; cavalry from the client states of Armenia, Characene and the Indo-Scythians was also mustered into his host. Two client monarchs stood on the Roman side: Artavasdes II of Armenia and Archelaus of Cappadocia, while Antiochus IV of Commagene backed Rome in the struggle over the Armenian crown against a brother of his own supported by Parthia. The third party was the trade routes of Mesopotamia and the western end of the Silk Road: Parthia wanted to hold Roman power at the eastern bank of the Euphrates, and Rome wanted to recover the wealth of the Armenian royal house held in Mesopotamia and to open the caravan road. Rome drew its reinforcements from the auxiliary troops of the provinces and from the cavalry of her allies, equipped in the Latin heavy-infantry system; the Parthian army was a complete Persian archery and armoured-cavalry system, and the two sides differed from the start in what they valued, firepower on one side and speed on the other.
people: 克拉蘇是這場戰爭的中心人物。公元前70年他與龐培同時出任執政官，公元前67年奉命接掌敘利亞，前66年進入亞細亞戰區，目標直指安息都城泰西封的方向。他放棄了幕僚昆圖斯在致西塞羅的信中提出的直取幼發拉底河東岸、輕裝速進的方案，堅持護住龐大的輜重車隊緩慢行軍，於是整場戰役被拖成在正午暑氣裡的慢戰。兒子普布利烏斯·李錫尼·克拉蘇以軍團百夫長身分參戰，前65年在亞美尼亞被蘇雷納斯的騎兵打散並被俘，父子從此再無會面。羅馬方面的其他關鍵人物包括幕僚加圖，他力主丟棄輜重、輕裝急行；前執政官卡西烏斯·隆吉努斯在克拉蘇之前就率軍掠取亞美尼亞王室的財富與人質，事後又被指控私吞戰利品與軍需貪瀆，幾乎毀掉克拉蘇的戰後處境；西塞羅則以書信往還把東方戰況傳回羅馬，並在公元前63年的演說裡把安息人變成政治籌碼。安息方面，國王歐羅德二世居中調度，蘇雷納斯以安息射手著稱，他對騎射兵的統一運用是全役的關鍵；王室貴族梅塞斯率重甲騎兵衝擊羅馬中軍時陣亡，國王之子帕庫魯斯與一名宦官分率右翼。附庸國家的騎兵多編入安息軍序列，亞美尼亞與查拉塞尼的部隊是其中最主要的一支。
peopleEn: Crassus stands at the centre of this war. He had been consul alongside Pompey in 70 BC, was sent to take over Syria in 67 BC, and entered the Asian theatre of operations in 66 BC with his objective pointing towards Ctesiphon, the Parthian capital. He rejected the plan proposed by his legate Quintus in a letter to Cicero - strike straight across the Euphrates and march in light order - and insisted on keeping the enormous baggage train under guard while advancing slowly, so that the whole campaign was turned into a slow war fought in the heat of midday. His son Publius Licinius Crassus served as a military tribune and was broken up and captured by Surenas' cavalry in Armenia in 65 BC; father and son never met again. Other key Roman figures were the legate Cato, who urged that the baggage be thrown away and the march hurried; the former consul Gaius Cassius Longinus, who had raided the Armenian royal house for wealth and hostages before Crassus arrived and who was afterwards accused of keeping the plunder and of corruption in the supply line, a charge that nearly ruined Crassus's position after the defeat; and Cicero, who carried news of the eastern front back to Rome in his letters and who turned the Parthians into a political counter in his speeches of 63 BC. On the Parthian side King Orodes II directed the campaign from the centre, while Surenas, famous for the Parthian shot, was the man whose unified employment of the horse-archers decided the battle; the royal noble Meyses led the armoured cavalry into the Roman centre and fell doing it; the king's son Pacorus and one of the eunuch commanders led the right wing. Client cavalry was drawn into the Parthian order of battle, the contingents of Armenia and Characene being the largest of them.
kits: 卡面是秦弩：弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓，春秋戰國以降一直是各國城防的標準火力，《墨子·公輸》所說架在城頭的懸機與可隨進的拒，就是這種機械弩，雲夢秦簡的軍器條文裡也把弩的儲備、調發與修造列為常規。這件兵器並不出現在前66年的美索不達米亞，它在這場戰爭裡的位置是對照件：安息人手中是複合反曲弓，弓身短而力大，能在奔馳中回身放箭；羅馬人手中則有與秦弩同族的機械弩，即車弩與弩炮，維特魯維烏斯《建築十書》第十卷描述了這些把扭力轉為箭矢的機器，但羅馬只在攻城與守營時倚賴它們，出野戰陣營便卸下不用。戰場上真正決定勝負的是安息人的合成弓與重甲騎兵：弓手配長箭袋，靠馬速換取射擊平台，用安息射法在假退與回身中持續傾瀉箭雨；重甲騎兵披馬鎧與鱗甲，持長矛與馬槌，是唯一敢衝進羅馬重步兵隊形的力量。羅馬步兵則仍是前3世紀的組合：重標槍、短劍、弧面大盾，鎧甲有分段甲與卡帕多西亞式鎖子甲；雙峰駱駝是安息軍趕路與攜帶彈藥的標準工具。
kitsEn: The card shows a Chinese crossbow: the trigger mechanism stores the pull, so the rate of fire far exceeds that of a bow, and from the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods onward it was standard defensive firepower for every state's walls. The suspending crossbow and the portable screen-mounted crossbow described in Mozi's Gongshu are exactly this machine, and the military-equipment clauses of the Qin bamboo slips from Yunmeng put the storing, issuing and repairing of crossbows into the regular order. The weapon did not appear in Mesopotamia in 66 BC, and its place in this war is that of a reference piece: what the Parthians held was the composite recurved bow, short in the limb and powerful, capable of shooting backwards at a gallop; what the Romans held was the mechanical crossbow of the same family, the carroballista and the cheiroballistra or scorpio, machines that Vitruvius describes in the tenth book of De architectura as converting torsion into a bolt, but Rome relied on them only in siege and in the defence of the camp, and had them uncoupled and left behind when the army went into the field. What actually decided the battle was the Parthian composite bow and the armoured cavalry: the bowmen carried long quivers, exchanged their platform for the speed of the horse, and kept pouring arrows under the Parthian shot during feigned retreats and shooting backwards; the cataphracts wore horse and rider in scale and lamellar armour, carried the long kontos and the sagaris, and were the only force willing to charge into the close order of the Roman heavy infantry. The Roman infantry remained a third-century combination: heavy pilum, gladius, curved oval scutum, with armour of segmented plate and Cappadocian chain mail; the double-humped dromedary was the standard animal for Parthian march and for carrying ammunition.
tactics: 卡萊一役的戰術可以從普魯塔克與卡西烏斯·狄奧的敘述裡重建。羅馬軍在克拉蘇的安排下分四線展開：最前是輕裝步兵與弓箭手，其後是六個軍團的重步兵主力，兩翼是羅馬騎兵，再後是輜重、車隊與輕裝隨軍人員，軍旗與預備隊則在中央。安息軍不急於接戰：蘇雷納斯率一萬騎射兵與一千重甲騎兵在左翼列陣，國王與帕庫魯斯在右翼，兩翼不斷以放箭與驅擾消耗羅馬前線，逼羅馬大軍在烈日與塵土下收縮成密集方陣。安息騎射兵的標準動作是接近到射程後假裝潰退，誘使羅馬騎兵追出，隨即四面合圍回身齊射；羅馬騎兵一旦脫離本陣，就再也無法回頭作戰。重甲騎兵在羅馬騎兵被牽制、步兵方陣出現裂口的時刻投入，長矛直取羅馬中軍的旗門；克拉蘇陣亡後，羅馬全軍崩潰，士兵被安息騎射兵包圍射殺，或在缺水、缺糧與酷熱中淪為俘虜。雙方勝負的關鍵差異在於：安息人把射擊當成騎兵的主要武器，全線不追求接戰；羅馬人把步兵方陣當成堡壘，卻缺少能在行軍與駐紮時反制馬上射擊的遠程機器，也沒有切斷敵人水源的辦法。
tacticsEn: The tactics of Carrhae can be reconstructed from the accounts of Plutarch and Cassius Dio. Crassus drew the Roman army up in four lines: light infantry and archers in front, the heavy infantry of the six legions behind them, the Roman cavalry on the wings, then the baggage, the wagon train and the light-armed camp followers, with the standards and the reserves in the centre. The Parthians were in no hurry to engage: Surenas drew up ten thousand horse-archers and a thousand cataphracts on the left, the king and Pacorus on the right, and the two wings wore down the Roman front with arrows and harassment, forcing the Roman mass to contract into a dense square under the sun and the dust. The standard movement of the Parthian horse-archers was to approach to bow range, pretend to break, draw the Roman cavalry out in pursuit, and then close in on four sides and shoot backwards; once the Roman cavalry had left the line it could never come back into the fight. The cataphracts were committed at the moment when the Roman horse was pinned and the infantry square opened a seam, the long kontos driving straight at the standards in the Roman centre; after Crassus fell the whole Roman army came apart, the men being shot down inside the Parthian cordon or taken prisoner in the absence of water and grain and in the heat. The decisive difference lay in this: Parthia treated shooting as the principal weapon of its cavalry and never sought close combat along the line, whereas Rome treated the infantry square as a fortress, yet had no long-range machine able to answer shooting from horseback on the march and in camp, and no way of cutting off the enemy's water.
data: 留下數字的地方主要有三處。第一是兵員：羅馬方面常被估算為六個軍團加上輔助部隊與騎兵，出戰總兵力在數萬之數，學界多落在四萬人前後，但沒有留下可核對的名冊；安息方面，普魯塔克記載卡萊一役投入騎射兵一萬、重甲騎兵一千，狄奧尼修斯·哈利卡納蘇斯給出的量級相近。第二是損失：羅馬軍的崩潰被說成陣亡約兩萬、被俘約一萬，狄奧尼修斯給的數字較低，約九千陣亡、七千被俘；普魯塔克另提到被俘者為數萬人，安息軍自身的損失只以百計。第三是時間與距離：羅馬軍自安提阿出發，經祖格馬渡過幼發拉底河，至卡萊的全程超過兩千公里；交戰日定在公元前68年8月9日的說法，來自近年刊布的密歇根殘卷，早年的研究多把此役定在公元前69年，而戰爭列表採用的起點年份是公元前66年，即克拉蘇進入敘利亞並整備軍備之年。行軍日數被安息人用拖延水源與襲擊偵騎拖成數週，羅馬軍的傷病與缺水因此急遽累積。
dataEn: Numbers survive in three main places. First, on strength: the Roman force is usually estimated at six legions together with auxiliary troops and cavalry, a total field army of tens of thousands, which scholarly estimates place around forty thousand, though no muster survives to check it; on the Parthian side Plutarch records ten thousand horse-archers and a thousand cataphracts committed at Carrhae, and Dionysius of Halicarnassus gives a comparable order of magnitude. Second, on losses: the collapse of the Roman army is given as about twenty thousand killed and ten thousand taken prisoner, while Dionysius gives lower figures of about nine thousand dead and seven thousand prisoners; Plutarch speaks in addition of tens of thousands of captives, while the Parthian losses count only in the hundreds. Third, on time and distance: the Roman army marched out from Antioch, crossed the Euphrates at Zeugma, and travelled more than two thousand kilometres to Carrhae; the dating of the battle to 9 August 68 BC comes from a Michigan papyrus published in recent years, while earlier scholarship placed the action in 69 BC, and the start year used in the list of wars is 66 BC, the year Crassus entered Syria and set his army in order. The number of days on the march was stretched out by the Parthians, who struck at the water supplies and the reconnaissance parties, and the sickness, wounds and thirst of the Roman army therefore accumulated rapidly.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最外面是地緣與商路：安息帝國控制著美索不達米亞與絲綢之路西段，羅馬在亞細亞的行省與商團希望在幼發拉底河以東取得立足點，而安息不願羅馬勢力越過河界。第二層是亞美尼亞：亞美尼亞王阿塔瓦德二世原是提格拉涅二世之子，憑羅馬的支援登上王位，安息支持他的兄弟安提柯四世奪位，亞美尼亞的角力直接把羅馬拖入河東戰事。第三層是財富與掠奪：卡西烏斯·隆吉努斯率軍攻入亞美尼亞，擄走王室成員與大批財貨，克拉蘇接手後又把目標放在同一批財富上，安息王的兄弟與美索不達米亞的財寶都被他視為應得的戰利品；安息國王則要追回這些掠物，並把克拉蘇視為必須剷除的威脅。第四層是羅馬內部的政治：克拉蘇的財富與三頭同盟中的弱勢位置，使他急需一場對外勝利來平衡龐培與凱撒，而流傳的說法是，他是想借安息人的手逼元老院解除龐培的軍權。真正開戰的導火線則是克拉蘇拒絕了安息提出的和談與歸還掠物的要求，逕行進兵美索不達米亞。
causeEn: There were four layers of cause. The outermost was geography and trade: the Parthian Empire held Mesopotamia and the western end of the Silk Road, the Roman provinces and merchant communities of Asia wanted a foothold east of the Euphrates, and Parthia would not let Roman power cross the river. The second layer was Armenia: Artavasdes II of Armenia was the son of Tigranes II and had taken the throne on Roman support, Parthia backed his brother Antiochus IV's claim, and the struggle over the Armenian crown pulled Rome directly into the war east of the river. The third layer was wealth and plunder: Cassius Longinus had led troops into Armenia and carried off members of the royal house and great quantities of treasure, and Crassus on taking over set his own sights on the same wealth, treating the brother of the Parthian king and the treasure of Mesopotamia as prizes properly his; the Parthian king in turn wanted the plunder back and treated Crassus as a menace to be removed. The fourth layer was domestic politics in Rome: Crassus's wealth and his weak position inside the triumvirate left him in desperate need of a foreign victory to balance Pompey and Caesar, and it was said that he meant to use the Parthians to force the senate to strip Pompey of his command. The immediate spark was Crassus's refusal of the Parthian offers of peace and of the return of the plunder, and his march into Mesopotamia in defiance of them.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是羅馬共和國史上最重的一次野戰失敗：六個軍團連同旗幟在一天之內被抹去，約兩萬人陣亡、一萬人被俘，安息人把羅馬的鷹旗與執政官的首級同時帶回泰西封，此後在羅馬的政治論辯裡被反覆引用。克拉蘇之死也重排了國內權力：元老院一度重新召喚龐培與凱撒，而西塞羅在公元前63年的演說中，把安息人騎馬進軍意大利的恐懼當成武器，反而替反對凱撒的人添亂，讓獨裁官的呼聲有了藉口。安息方面則獲得數年緩衝期，得以重新收編美索不達米亞的附庸、整頓卡帕多西亞與亞美尼亞的局勢，並在公元前58年至前63年再度攻入安息境內，捲入安東尼的安息戰爭。長期看，這場敗仗決定了羅馬對東方千年的政策取向：奧古斯都放棄深入兩河流域，改以幼發拉底河為界、把亞美尼亞與科瑪吉尼置於羅馬屏障之後的附庸體系；卡萊之役的教訓也進入兵書與軍事學院，成為步兵方陣對馬上射擊這道題的標準案例，直到近代軍事學仍在重算安息射法與重甲衝鋒之間的交換比。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this war was the heaviest defeat suffered in the field by the Roman Republic in its history: six legions and their standards were wiped out in a single day, some twenty thousand men were killed and ten thousand taken prisoner, and the Parthians carried the Roman aquilae and the head of the consul back to Ctesiphon together, where it was referred to again and again in the political arguments of Rome. The death of Crassus also reordered the balance of power at home: the senate briefly called for Pompey and Caesar once more, and in his speeches of 63 BC Cicero used the fear of Parthian horsemen riding into Italy as a weapon, which instead muddied the waters for Caesar's opponents and gave the demand for a dictator a pretext. Parthia gained several years of breathing space, in which it reabsorbed the clients of Mesopotamia, reorganised the situation in Cappadocia and Armenia, and in 58-63 BC once more drove into Roman-held territory, drawing Antony into his Parthian war. In the long run this defeat settled the orientation of Roman policy towards the East for a thousand years: Augustus gave up any attempt to penetrate Mesopotamia, and instead made the Euphrates the line, with Armenia and Commagene placed behind the Roman shield as a system of client kingdoms; and the lesson of Carrhae entered the military manuals and the academies as the standard case of the infantry square against shooting from horseback, a problem whose exchange ratio modern military studies are still recalculating.
result: 卡萊的結局是安息式的完勝：克拉蘇在混戰中陣亡，羅馬六個軍團被全數消滅，殘兵不是被俘，就是潰散在美索不達米亞的荒原與城邑之間，安息人只以數百人的代價換來羅馬的鷹旗、旗幟與大量俘虜，俘虜被轉賣為奴。安息國王歐羅德二世在戰場與宮廷都得到了想要的結果，亞美尼亞重新回到安息影響的圈內，兩河流域的門戶向東敞開。但羅馬很快換了打法：龐培被派往東方，公元前62年與安息談判，迫使安息放棄對亞美尼亞的直接控制，只保留一個緩衝國，並以定期支付換取歸還從克拉蘇那裡繳獲的軍旗；公元前54年安息王再提出以歸還軍旗換取兵馬與金錢，被卡西烏斯·隆吉努斯當場拒絕，軍旗直到公元前51年卡西烏斯擊殺帕庫魯斯之後才真正回到羅馬手中，此後羅馬再沒有組織過深入兩河流域的大軍。戰役的真正遺產不在戰場上：安息射法與重甲騎兵的搭配被後世的兵書、軍事學院教材與現代騎兵研究反覆引用，而克拉蘇不肯拋下輜重、以致誤了戰機的那段決策，也成了後世將領最常援引的反面教材，提醒所有人速度與補給之間那道永遠算不過來的帳。
resultEn: The outcome at Carrhae was a complete Parthian victory: Crassus was killed in the melee, the six Roman legions were annihilated, and the survivors were either taken prisoner or scattered across the wastes and towns of Mesopotamia, while the Parthians paid only a few hundred men for the Roman aquilae, the standards and a great mass of prisoners who were then sold into slavery. King Orodes II got what he wanted on the field and at court, Armenia returned to the Parthian sphere of influence, and the door of Mesopotamia stood open towards the east. Rome changed its method quickly, however: Pompey was sent to the East, negotiated with Parthia in 62 BC, and forced it to give up direct control of Armenia, keeping only a buffer state, while paying an annual sum for the return of the standards captured from Crassus; in 54 BC the Parthian king offered again to give the standards back for horsemen and money, and was refused on the spot by Cassius Longinus. The standards did not actually return to Roman hands until 51 BC, when Cassius killed Pacorus, and after that Rome never again assembled a great army for a deep march into Mesopotamia. The true legacy of the battle lies off the field: the pairing of the Parthian shot with the armoured charge has been quoted again and again by later manuals, by the textbooks of the military academies and by modern cavalry studies, while the decision by Crassus not to throw away his baggage, and the loss of the initiative that followed, has become the most frequently cited cautionary example in the education of generals, a reminder of the account between speed and supply that can never be settled in advance.
